title: SpeCal: Spectral Calibration for Unsupervised RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2611.20691v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its dependence on ground-truth answers or external verifiers limits its ability to exploit abundant unlabeled reasoning data. Unsupervised RLVR alleviates this bottleneck by deriving scalar rewards from the model's own rollouts. However, the reliability of such self-generated supervision varies substantially across rollout groups and individual responses, while existing methods construct or refine their rewards mainly from decoded outcomes and reward statistics. These endpoint signals reveal what answers the model produces, but provide limited information about whether the underlying rollout representations form a reliable structure for learning. translated_title: SpeCal：面向无监督RLVR的频谱校准
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其对真实答案或外部验证器的依赖限制了其利用大量无标注推理数据的能力。无监督RLVR通过从模型自身的采样输出中推导标量奖励来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，这种自生成监督的可靠性在不同采样组和单个响应之间差异很大，而现有方法主要从解码结果和奖励统计中构建或优化奖励。这些末端信号只揭示了模型产生了什么答案，对于底层采样表示是否形成了可靠的学习结构则提供的信息有限。我们的关键观察是，隐藏状态频谱通过表征采样组内部的组织结构及（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SpeCal，利用隐藏状态频谱信息来校准无监督RLVR中自生成奖励的可靠性，弥补仅依赖解码结果和奖励统计的不足，从而更好地利用无标注推理数据提升模型推理能力。
en_tdlr: SpeCal leverages hidden-state spectral information to calibrate the reliability of self-generated rewards in unsupervised RLVR, providing a complementary signal beyond decoded outcomes and reward statistics for learning from unlabeled reasoning data.
